name: Customer email normalization backfill
description: Tests whether a legacy email update can leave the normalized email stale after a backfill.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE customer_accounts (id INT PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL, normalized_email TEXT);

phases.name: Backfill
phases.description: Populate normalized emails for existing accounts.

phases.name: Compatibility
phases.description: Exercise a legacy writer during migration.

backfill_email.description: Populate normalized_email from the current email value.
backfill_email.sql: UPDATE customer_accounts SET normalized_email = lower(email) WHERE normalized_email IS NULL;

legacy_email_write.description: Change only the legacy email column.
legacy_email_write.sql: UPDATE customer_accounts SET email = 'New@Example.com' WHERE id = 11;

new_app_read.description: Read the normalized email used after cutover.
new_app_read.sql: SELECT id, normalized_email FROM customer_accounts WHERE id = 11;

invariants.name: Email consistency
invariants.description: The normalized email must equal the lowercase legacy email whenever it is populated.
invariants.sql: SELECT id, email, normalized_email FROM customer_accounts WHERE normalized_email IS NOT NULL AND normalized_email <> lower(email);
